title.tr: Bahçe Deposu ve Ahşap Deck Zemin
title.en: Garden Storage Shed with Wooden Deck

alt.tr: Yeşil çatılı ahşap bahçe deposu, yatay kaplamalı kapısı ve önünde deck zemin; yanda istiflenmiş odun kütükleri
alt.en: Wooden garden shed with a green roof and horizontally clad door, deck floor in front and stacked logs beside it

caption.tr: Yatay lambri kaplı küçük bahçe deposu, kapısı ve önündeki ahşap deck zeminle birlikte. Yan tarafta odun istifi duruyor.
caption.en: A small garden shed clad in horizontal boards, with its door and the wooden deck floor in front. A stack of firewood sits to one side.
